_doc: Touchstone passes per module that CI must keep (check-floor.py). Raise with the change that earns it.
_supported_doc: Each *-when-unsupported test that probes the absence of a feature this server supports, mapped to the pattern its inapplicable reason must match (the precondition that found the feature advertised). It counts toward its module's floor only when inapplicable for that reason; a pass, any other outcome or reason, or its absence fails the check.
